name: Lastlight Beacon v1 — OSRS-Inspired Building Grammar
subtitle: Readable low-poly masonry, strong openings, warm construction materials, and functional circulation
review_note: The original lighthouse preserves the reference's readable low-poly building grammar while adding a landmark silhouette: hand-laid tapered masonry, exaggerated fitted openings, structural buttresses, stained glass, a corbelled walk, octagonal lantern room and weathered copper crown. It is deliberately wider because its complete 64-tile stair and accessible top are gameplay requirements.
improve: Validate close-camera wall cutaway and the complete stair route in the real game; do not shrink the 17.6-tile interior.
